deployments_detail.use: SMBC-GAI (originally piloted as SMBC-GPT): in-house generative AI assistant for all employees, embedded in Microsoft Teams, used for drafting, summarizing, translation, and code generation over the internal network. Reached ~12,000 daily uses ('once every two seconds'). [Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service; co-developed with Japan Research Institute (JRI) and NEC]

AI-CEO: internal chatbot and avatar modeled on Group CEO using system prompts and RAG, deployed to employees to normalize AI use and share management perspective; chatbot version rolled out to staff. [OpenAI GPT-4o; Microsoft avatar technology]

Agentic AI embedded in banking workflows via kAIgentic (Singapore venture SMFG invested in), designed to automate data extraction and complex banking operations with source-traceable outputs; being deployed within SMBC Group banking workflows. [kAIgentic Pte Ltd (founded by Ahmed Mazhari)]
"SMBC-GAI" employee AI assistant; multi-LLM strategy (incl. Gemini); ~100 concurrent GenAI projects
deployments_detail.value: JPY500bn GenAI investment frame; JPY1tn 3yr DX

deployments_detail.use: Proposal Generation AI: multi-agent system (information gathering, hypothesis/story building, quality evaluation and fact-checking agents) that automates strategic proposal generation for wholesale banking clients; reached production deployment at SMBC. [Sakana AI]

AI-powered data analytics / demand forecasting business jointly developed with Fujitsu (Dynamic Ensemble Model) for product demand, inventory, personnel, and logistics optimization; demonstration experiments and service provision planned. [Fujitsu]

Healthcare fintech initiative deploying AI to generate clinical documentation, support nursing administration, and automate DPC coding for medical fee claims across hospitals; broader ambition to serve ~60 million users and 4,000 medical institutions. [Fujitsu; IBM Japan]

SMBC-GAI applied to call center / contact center support, helping agents keep records of customer conversations and access information, with human-AI division of labor. [Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service]

AVACOM AI-powered digital customer-service avatars trialed in the corporate customer contact center, letting customers interact with human-like avatars for product/service explanations by phone. [AVITA (AVACOM)]
Multi-agent "proposal document auto-generation" app for wholesale business (with Sakana AI)

Sales Promotion AI Application: AI app for wholesale-banking lead identification and sales promotion, released as the front end of an end-to-end wholesale workflow paired with the Proposal Generation AI. [Sakana AI]
